attribute.digest: If set to 1 (default) other jam.helios object will be notified if an device scan has been exectued
attribute.description: If set to 1 (default) other jam.helios object will be notified if an device scan has been exectued. The new result will update all umenus connected to the leftmost outlet.

attribute.name: samplerate
attribute.digest: Points per second send to the laser projector
attribute.description:
Points per second send to the laser projector.
Note:It is recommended to keep sampling rate at 30000 or below, as higher values can cause problems in certain devices like LaserCube Wifi
